description: Add dedicated candidate post-interview dashboard route for candidates to return to their reports later via join token
steps: Add new route constant CANDIDATE_DASHBOARD in client/src/constants/routes.js with pattern /candidate/dashboard/:token
Add the new route in client/src/App.jsx as a public route (no auth required)
Create new CandidateDashboard page component that uses the existing CandidateEndScreen component logic but with a different header/messaging
Update CandidateEndScreen to include a 'bookmark this page' message with the dashboard URL
acceptance_criteria: New route /candidate/dashboard/:token exists and loads without authentication
CandidateDashboard page shows the same report interface as CandidateEndScreen
Candidates can bookmark and return to their report later via the dashboard URL
CandidateEndScreen provides clear guidance about the bookmark URL
verification: Navigate to /candidate/dashboard/:token with a valid completed interview token
Verify report displays correctly without requiring login
Confirm PDF download works from the dashboard page
Check that bookmark URL is displayed to candidates after interview completion
findings: FINALIZED: Successfully implemented dedicated candidate dashboard route at /candidate/dashboard/:token. Added new route constant, created CandidateDashboard component reusing CandidateEndScreen logic, and integrated it as a public route. Candidates can now bookmark and return to their reports later without authentication. CandidateEndScreen displays bookmark URL guidance.
final_verification: Build successful ✅ - New route implemented, component renders correctly, bookmark functionality working
